tests.name: all nine workspace views delegate to the approved scoped APIs in a consistent snapshot
unconfigured public tenant returns an empty gallery, without private fallbacks
session, Origin, CSRF, verified identity and customer-only admin access fail closed
branches can be created after a calendar exists, without enabling booking
branch metadata updates preserve activation; timezone changes with schedules are rejected
service creation and inactive branch offering reuse the existing command boundary
real offering price/duration and confirmed physical requirements persist with row CAS
forged price fields, missing confirmation and cross-tenant offering references are rejected
concurrent admin price updates have one CAS winner and one stale rejection
current branch-local instant conversion uses the original IANA resolver
staff creation and future membership use the unchanged workforce API and version
published shifts remain readable through the hardened calendar projection
existing policy create/publish APIs freeze a version and reject silent edits
the unchanged booking flow creates a real non-payment confirmation in integration
admin price edits leave accepted booking terms and prices byte-identical
capacity edits with an active reservation fail closed
admin cancellation requires scope, CAS, explicit confirmation and records a reason
branch-scoped readers cannot inspect another branch or global media
manual upload produces actual private optimized variants, without publication rights
two uploads racing during real authorization admit exactly one processor and release the gate
parallel authenticated thumbnail delivery preserves session security without serialization failures
upload retries retain one asset identity and never overwrite immutable objects
wrong CSRF is rejected before native processing and does not create media records
publication without an active rights attestation is denied
category and accessible public metadata persist with actual server validation
a media editor cannot assert rights or publish without the separate permissions
rights require affirmative confirmation and a private evidence reference
only explicitly published approved media appears, with no private fields
real WebP delivery strips source metadata and supports Range and HEAD safely
metadata edits and renewed rights each require a separate new publication
invalid category edits roll back metadata, version and publication atomically
media original identity and source object references cannot be rewritten
revoke immediately removes gallery membership and stops new derivative requests
rights and derivative evidence are immutable even for trusted SQL edits
ZIP import accepts nested safe media, atomically private and without rights
ZIP traversal, symlinks, duplicate names, non-media, excessive count and bombs fail atomically
a malformed file in an otherwise valid ZIP cannot leave partially registered media
video is actually transcoded to faststart H264 with WebP thumbnail/poster and ranged delivery
local storage rejects traversal and mutation, and byte ranges validate safe bounds
S3 adapter rejects insecure remote endpoints and absent private bucket settings
original native capacity constraints and table/function privilege boundary remain intact
